V4 (original V4.1)

Realized CellCycleScoreing and related statistics are calculated with one human only gene name "Hn1", which should be "Jpt1". Should only affect cellcyclescoring, counts, and plots. Should not affect clustering and DEGs.

Then realized another 2 outdated genes: Fam64a -> Pimreg; Mlf1ip-> Cenpu
https://github.com/liuyigh/tinyatlas/blob/master/cell_cycle/Mus_musculus.csv

Confirmed with python sets that three genes are different. Hence redo cell cycle.

## See Enrichr Analysis of 56 genes


```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
```

## Fix three cell cycle gene error here
```{r}
firstup <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(x)
  substr(x, 1, 1) <- toupper(substr(x, 1, 1))
  x
}

s.genes <- firstup(cc.genes$s.genes)
g2m.genes <- firstup(cc.genes$g2m.genes)
library(stringr)
g2m.genes <- str_replace(g2m.genes, 'Hn1', 'Jpt1')
g2m.genes <- str_replace(g2m.genes, 'Fam64a', 'Pimreg')
s.genes <- str_replace(s.genes, 'Mlf1ip', 'Cenpu')


dc <- CellCycleScoring(dc, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, set.ident = TRUE)
```

```{r}
cccounts <- table(dc$Phase, dc$seurat_clusters)
write.csv(cccounts, "cccounts.csv")
cccounts.pct <- round(prop.table(cccounts, 2)*100, 1)
write.csv(cccounts.pct, "cccounts-pct.csv")

library(ggplot2)
library(ggheatmap)
ggheatmap(as.data.frame.matrix(cccounts.pct), colorPalette = "PuRd")

```

## subset relevant clusters.
```{r}
Idents(dc) <- "seurat_clusters"
dcSub <- subset(dc, idents = c(0,1,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,11))

dcSub <- NormalizeData(dcSub)
dcSub <- FindVariableFeatures(dcSub, selection.method = "mean.var.plot")
dcSub <- ScaleData(dcSub, features = VariableFeatures(dcSub))
dcSub <- RunPCA(dcSub, features = VariableFeatures(dcSub))

VizDimLoadings(dcSub, dims = 1:4, reduction = "pca")
DimHeatmap(dcSub, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(dcSub, ndims = 40)
dcSub <- JackStraw(dcSub, num.replicate = 100, dims = 50)
dcSub <- ScoreJackStraw(dcSub, dims = 1:40)

# 'Significant' PCs will show a strong enrichment of features with low p-values (solid curve above the dashed line). 
JackStrawPlot(dcSub, dims = 1:40)
```

```{r}
dcSub <- FindNeighbors(dcSub, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:29)
dcSub <- RunTSNE(dcSub, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:20)
dcSub <- RunUMAP(dcSub, dims = 1:20)

#FeaturePlot(dcSub, features = "nFeature_RNA", split.by = "HTO_maxID", ncol = 2)

#dcSub <- FindClusters(dcSub, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE) #13 clusters
#dcSub <- FindClusters(dcSub, resolution = 0.3, verbose = FALSE) #10 clusters
dcSub <- FindClusters(dcSub, resolution = 0.2, verbose = FALSE) #7 clusters
#DimPlot(dcSub, reduction = "tsne", split = "HTO_maxID")
DimPlot(dcSub, split.by = "HTO_maxID") #UMAP better
```

```{r}
clusMarkers <- FindAllMarkers(dcSub, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
```

Clusters: 
=========
use ARCHS4 Tissues and Mouse Gene Atlas on ENRichr, look at individual genes

|#  |Prof|    Cell type           |Genes               |Datbase|Confidence Fold change|
|---|--|--------------------------|--------------------|-------|-----------|
|0  |++|HSPCs                     |Hist1h1b/Top2a(DNA) |Archs4 | poor  |
|1  |- |DC1                       |high MHCII          |Archs4 |
|2  |+ |?BM/CD34+/TBlast          |Hells/Ctr9/Myl10    |Archs4 | poor  |
|3  |- |pDC                       |Siglech Ccr9 Ctsl   |Archs4 |
|4  |+ |Neutrophil/GMP/Baso       |Elane/Mpo/Ctsg/Cd63 |GeneFunc/MAtlas |
|5  |- |Early lymph               |Ly6d                |Archs4 |
|6  |+ |CD8 DCs           |Ctr9/Myl10          |Archs4 | poor  |

### recluster DC main
realized that clusters and data changed after redo cell cycle, decide to regress all the cells again, instead of just regressing the DC subsets above.

## Regress cell cycle using alternative workflow
```{r}
dc$CC.Difference <- dc$S.Score - dc$G2M.Score
dcReg <- ScaleData(dc, vars.to.regress = "CC.Difference", features = rownames(dc))
```

```{r}
dcReg <- RunPCA(dcReg, features = VariableFeatures(dcReg), nfeatures.print = 10)

VizDimLoadings(dcReg, dims = 1:4, reduction = "pca")
DimHeatmap(dcReg, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
```

Negative:  Anxa1, Pglyrp1, Wfdc21, Lcn2, Ngp, Pygl, Lyz2, S100a8, Camp, C3

Negative:  Rpsa, Cst3, Rplp0, Ctss, S100a4, Ms4a4c, Ifitm1, Ifitm2, Tmem176b, Ms4a6b 
PC_ 3 
Positive:  Btg1, Cd74, H2-Aa, H2-Eb1, Ctss, H2-Ab1, Marcks, Btg2, Ifi27l2a, Slfn5 
Negative:  Mki67, Prtn3, H2afx, Cenpf, Hsp90ab1, Hist1h1b, Hist1h2ap, Ctsg, Ube2c, Hist1h2ae 
PC_ 4 
Positive:  Siglech, Ctsl, Ccr9, Runx2, Pacsin1, Cox6a2, Pltp, Upb1, Tcf4, Cd7

```{r}
dcReg <- FindNeighbors(dcReg, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:29)
```

# Now compare between WT and KO in cluster 1

```{r}
dcSRClu1 <- subset(dcSubReg, seurat_clusters == 1)
Idents(dcSRClu1) <- "HTO_maxID"
SRclu1Mkr <- FindMarkers(dcSRClu1, ident.1 = c("Hash1","Hash3"), ident.2 = c("Hash2", "Hash5"), min.pct = 0.10, logfc.threshold = 0.10)
SRclu1Mkr$pctDiff <- abs(SRclu1Mkr$pct.1 - SRclu1Mkr$pct.2)
SRclu1Mkr$pctFold1 <- SRclu1Mkr$pct.1 / SRclu1Mkr$pct.2
SRclu1Mkr$pctFold2 <- SRclu1Mkr$pct.2 / SRclu1Mkr$pct.1
SRclu1Mkr$pctFold <- apply(SRclu1Mkr[c(7,8)], 1, max)
write.csv(SRclu1Mkr, "DEG-Clu1-CCSubReg-20191111.csv")
```

# Next few blocks trying to find the relationship between DEG and its dropout rates (as pct cell expressing that gene).

## drop out rates distribution in cluster 1
```{r}
pct.clu1 <- round(
                  rowSums(as.data.frame(dcSRClu1@assays$RNA@data)>0) /
                  length(colnames(dcSRClu1)),
                  digits = 3
                  )

pct.clu1 <- as.data.frame(pct.clu1)
p <- ggplot(pct.clu1, aes(x='', y=pct.clu1)) +
geom_violin()
p + geom_boxplot(width=0.1)
```
Plot total counts of one gene and pct cell expressing that gene in all cells, red dot Mid1

```{r}
gene.counts.clu1 <- rowSums(as.data.frame(dcSRClu1@assays$RNA@counts))
gene.counts.clu1 <- as.data.frame(gene.counts.clu1)
gene.counts.and.zero <- merge(gene.counts.clu1, pct.clu1, by = 0)
ggplot(gene.counts.and.zero, aes(x=gene.counts.clu1+1, y=pct.clu1)) + geom_point(size = 0.1) +geom_point(data = gene.counts.and.zero[gene.counts.and.zero$Row.names == 'Mid1',], size = 3, color = 'red')+ scale_x_continuous(trans='log10')+
      geom_label_repel(data=  gene.counts.and.zero[gene.counts.and.zero$Row.names == 'Mid1',], aes(label = 'Mid1', color = 'red'),
                      box.padding = unit(1.5, 'lines'),
                  segment.color = 'deepskyblue'
                  )+ NoLegend()
```

```{r}
ggplot(gene.counts.and.zero.KO, aes(x=gene.counts.clu1KO+1, y=pct.clu1KO)) + geom_point(size = 0.1) +
  geom_point(data = gene.counts.and.zero.KO[gene.counts.and.zero.KO$Row.names == 'Mid1',], size = 3, color = 'red')+ scale_x_continuous(trans='log10')+
      geom_label_repel(data=  gene.counts.and.zero.KO[gene.counts.and.zero.KO$Row.names == 'Mid1',], aes(label = 'Mid1', color = 'red'),
                      box.padding = unit(1.5, 'lines'),
                  segment.color = 'deepskyblue'
                  )+ NoLegend()
```

find DEGs between cluster 1 and 2, two progenitor clusters
```{r}
Idents(dcSubReg) <- "seurat_clusters"
Clu12Mkr <- FindMarkers(dcSubReg, ident.1 = 1, ident.2 = 2, min.pct = 0.10, logfc.threshold = 0.10)
Clu12Mkr$pctDiff <- abs(Clu12Mkr$pct.1 - Clu12Mkr$pct.2)
Clu12Mkr$pctFold1 <- Clu12Mkr$pct.1 / Clu12Mkr$pct.2
Clu12Mkr$pctFold2 <- Clu12Mkr$pct.2 / Clu12Mkr$pct.1
Clu12Mkr$pctFold <- apply(Clu12Mkr[c(7,8)], 1, max)
write.csv(Clu12Mkr, "~/scRNAseq/analysis/DEGs/DEG-CCRegSub/DEG-Clu1v2-CCSubReg-20191118.csv")
```
